ideas.title: Investigating Minnesota Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the allegations of child care fraud in Minnesota and the response by state and federal authorities.
questions: What is the extent of child care fraud in Minnesota?
How have state and federal authorities responded to the allegations?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a larger pattern of corruption or wrongdoing in Minnesota's child care system. By following the money and investigating the allegations, we may be able to identify key players and determine the extent of the fraud.
